scholarships.title: Kishore Vaigyanik Protsahan Yojana (KVPY)
scholarships.description: Fellowship program to encourage students to pursue research careers in science
benefits: Monthly fellowship during undergraduate and postgraduate studies
Annual contingency grant for academic expenses
requirements: Strong academic record in science subjects
Commitment to pursue research career in science

scholarships.title: INSPIRE Scholarship
scholarships.provider: Department of Science & Technology, Govt. of India
scholarships.eligibility: Top 1% students in Class 12 board exams
scholarships.description: Scholarship for pursuing undergraduate studies in natural sciences
requirements: Secure position in top 1% in Class 12 board examinations
Pursue BSc/BTech/Integrated MS in natural sciences

scholarships.title: National Talent Search Examination (NTSE)
scholarships.description: National level scholarship examination for talented students
benefits: Priority consideration in various educational programs
requirements: Clear state level and national level examinations

scholarships.title: J.N. Tata Endowment for Higher Education
scholarships.description: Loan scholarship for higher studies abroad in various fields
benefits: Access to Tata network and mentorship

scholarships.title: Sitaram Jindal Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.description: Merit-based scholarship for academically excellent students
requirements: Family income below ₹2.5 lakhs per annum
